name: v267_editorial_equity_pure_no_story
hypothesis: If the v266 edge is truly broad-sentiment contrarian rather than novelty/story-count event capacity, the pure editorial/equity fade should retain strength while reducing correlation to WjpJwMdP and omKZRRn2.
field_notes: Removes news_impact_projection_score and story_event_record_count from qMAJxLd1 to cut the event-attention carrier.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.550 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(editorial_commentary_sentiment_2), 126), industry) + 0.450 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(equity_sentiment_score), 126), industry), -1)

name: v267_editorial_sentiment_disagreement
hypothesis: Broad editorial/equity sentiment is more independent when it is not aligned with event-level sentiment; disagreement may represent crowded narrative pressure rather than ordinary news impact.
field_notes: Uses direct VECTOR sentiment disagreement, no story-count, no novelty-chain, no impact-projection sleeve.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(editorial_commentary_sentiment_2), 126), industry) + 0.320 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(equity_sentiment_score), 126), industry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(abs(vec_avg(composite_sentiment_score_2) - vec_avg(event_sentiment_score)), 90), industry), -1)

name: v267_editorial_anti_novelty_blocker
hypothesis: Explicitly offsetting the WjpJwMdP novelty/low-story-count carrier may keep the editorial contrarian sleeve but reduce self-correlation.
field_notes: This is the only explicit blocker-removal expression; it subtracts novelty-chain exposure and flips the low-story-count exposure from WjpJwMdP.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.50, 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(editorial_commentary_sentiment_2), 126), industry) + 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(equity_sentiment_score), 126), industry) - 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(global_novelty_chain_elapsed_ms), 126), industry) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry), -1)

name: v267_editorial_largecap_subindustry_slow
hypothesis: A slower, stricter large-cap, subindustry-ranked editorial/equity fade may reduce event-attention and payout-quality correlation while improving sub-universe robustness.
field_notes: No direct event impact/story-count sleeves; changes group and cap gate as a robustness test rather than a minor window tweak.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.65, 0.600 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(editorial_commentary_sentiment_2), 180), subindustry) + 0.400 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(equity_sentiment_score), 180), subindustry), -1)
